source.cross_check: this sha256 is identical to source_sha256 in evidence/iap2-pending-ack-recovery.json, so the bytes examined here are the same accessoryd the earlier 78-case probe used

segment_map.note: file offset == virtual address - 0x100000000, so no slide arithmetic is needed

call_sites_scan.method: decode every BL in __TEXT and compare the computed destination
call_sites_scan.caveat: indirect calls through vtables would not be visible to this scan; no vtable entry pointing at 0x100170bb0 was seen, but that was not exhaustively enumerated (WS-OPEN-06)

caller.name: _iap2_wifisharing__startFeatureFromDevice
caller.meaning: 0x5702 is the start action of feature 22, so a session emits it once and only a new feature start could emit it again

direction_calibration.ground_truth: _iap2_wifisharing_RequestWiFiInformation @0x10017020c compares the inbound message id against 0x5700 at 0x10017024c, so 5700 is received and 5701 is sent
direction_calibration.derivation: direction 1 = the phone sends it, 0 = the car sends it
direction_calibration.grade: INFERRED: consistent over two independent groups, not read from the consuming function

required_group.flag_semantics: OPEN: the third field is 1 in all four entries of both groups; nothing here proves it means required/count

gate.code: protocol-carplay/.../IapIdentificationValidation.kt:29 wifiHandoff = [(0x5702,1), (0x5703,0)]; group() needs both directions declared before feature 22 is added to validatedMessageFeatures
gate.verdict: aligned; the local rule tuples are the firmware descriptor tuples

wait_budget.code: Bootstrap.kt:112 ANNOUNCEMENT_WAIT_MS = 30_000, break at :477, HANDOFF_FAILED at :498
wait_budget.firmware: the sender carries no timeout; the upper-layer budget is unread (WS-OPEN-04)
wait_budget.verdict: OPEN: a locally chosen constant, not a value read from the firmware. This record does not claim 30s is wrong, only that it has no counterpart yet

implementation_alignment.not_claimed: none of the above explains why the car stays silent, and none of it explains the car reboot

branch_experiment_not_upstream.what: a work branch outside this repository added a 5s resend loop with a 25s budget, up to 6 frames of 0x5702
branch_experiment_not_upstream.observed: 2026-11-06 22:12 six frames were sent and the same car then power-cycled; after the loop was withdrawn the same car released the session by itself at 78s
branch_experiment_not_upstream.grade: OBSERVED, single vehicle, single night, no control run; not generalisable
branch_experiment_not_upstream.use: supports the static conclusion that resending puts pressure on a stuck car; it is not evidence about the firmware

open_items: WS-OPEN-01 car-side session occupancy and release: needs head-unit firmware or head-unit logs; a single observed release time is a runtime observation only
WS-OPEN-02 semantics of _iAP2MsgInit argument 0xffff and the two trailing zeros
WS-OPEN-03 semantics of the third descriptor field
WS-OPEN-04 the upper-layer budget that gives up on a silent 0x5702, including whether it produces a 1D03 refusal
WS-OPEN-05 whether IapLink retransmission is equivalent to _sendOutgoingMessage
WS-OPEN-06 whether an indirect call through a vtable can also reach 0x100170bb0
